summary: Tests-writing (red-phase) run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Committed: 21 permanent unit tests across three files pinning the generated-client contract, the app facade over generated types, and the vendored OpenAPI document itself; plus LID docs reconstructing the published spec from viamin/color_matching (vendored YAML validated as OpenAPI 3.0.3 with openapi-spec-validator; every test fixture schema-validated against it) and the contract-delta analysis for the PR description. The Swift tests are intentionally red: they import the ColorMatchingOpenAPI module that the implementation run must add (tests-only phase cannot modify iOS/Package.swift or add sources). No Swift toolchain exists in this container (command not found), so swift test --disable-sandbox could not be executed locally; CI (macOS) runs it. Expected implementation deltas are enumerated in docs/color-matching-openapi-deltas.md (D1-D8, G1-G4, N1-N4, V1-V4).
